alerts.title: Iran war live: IRGC says four tankers struck mines in Strait of Hormuz
alerts.why: Strait of Hormuz mine strikes threaten massive global oil supply disruptions, driving strong risk premiums into crude prices.

alerts.title: Oil Prices Head for Fourth Monthly Gain as Middle East Tensions Escalate
alerts.why: Escalating Middle East tensions, Houthi threats to Saudi infrastructure, and potential post-election U.S. strikes on Iran heavily support four-month high crude prices.

itemsSent.title: Oil prices edge lower as renewed U.S.-Iran peace efforts ease supply fears
itemsSent.why: Renewed U.S.-Iran peace negotiations eased Middle East supply disruption fears, removing geopolitical risk premium and pushing oil prices lower.

itemsSent.title: Greek Containership Sunk by Naval Drones Off Bulgaria as Black Sea Attacks Escalate
itemsSent.why: Escalating Black Sea attacks raise geopolitical risk premiums for European maritime shipping and regional crude supply flows.

itemsSent.title: FUJAIRAH DATA: Oil product stockpiles climb to five-week high, led by light distillates
itemsSent.why: Fujairah light distillate inventories surged 49% to a five-week high, signaling weak regional gasoline and naphtha demand.
